text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer was approached by Sakura 
Laurel for advice. It seems she feels pain 
whenever a heavy strain is put on her 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Trainer hears from 
Sakura Chiyono O, who is deeply worried 
that Sakura Laurel might ruin her legs by 
staking everything on a single dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the Trainer says they cannot take 
away Sakura Laurel's dream. If she wishes 
to run, they have resolved to dream 
together with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's legs are fragile, so 
pushing herself is forbidden. Fully aware 
of this, she decided to focus for now on 
solidifying the mental image of her ideal 
running form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reviews her rivals' races and 
dedicates her rest time to studying. All 
in the belief that it will lead to her 
dream.
